description:
pattern     dock-strip / header
surface     dark
kit         none
form        Header bar spans full width fixed at the top with a blurred glass background, housing the student logotype on the left, a centered desktop navigation menu, and a magnetic primary button on the right. On mobile, the navigation links collapse into an accessible slide-over drawer triggered by a minimal hamburger button.
copy
  logo         THARINDU PERERA
  nav-journey  Journey
  nav-faculty  Faculty
  nav-achieve  Achievements
  nav-projects Projects
  nav-memories Memories
  nav-contact  Contact
  cta-button   Explore My Journey
motion      Container fades in at 0ms with backdrop blur ramp; navigation elements stagger at 40ms intervals up to 240ms.
plan check  logo/name placed at left; nav links (Journey, Faculty, Achievements, Projects, Memories, Contact) placed in center menu; "Explore My Journey" button placed at right action slot.
layout_description: One full-width sticky navigation bar with left brand wordmark, center link group, and right action button.
